phone.text: Hiii, it's Tiwa from the brunch. So I was thinking, Sunday, you and me...

beats.text: Golden hour. A voice note from a number you saved as 'Tiwa Brunch 🥂'. You press play.
Mid-sentence, a ring light clicks on behind her voice. A phone camera shutter. Then another.
Say hi to my followers, babe. They've been asking about you since Tuesday.
You haven't met her yet. She's already filming you.

chemistry_leaks.text: She angles her phone to get you in the frame. 'You photograph well. That's rare.'
'Who does your hair? Don't lie. I'll know.'
She checks the label on your sleeve without asking. She approves without saying so.
She looks you up and down once, the way a vendor checks a transfer receipt.
She forgets to film the first ten minutes. She never forgets to film.

locked_in.title: Soft Life, Hard Launch
locked_in.text: She hard-launched you: your hand, her nails, no filter. The caption just says 'mine'. Her followers are still recovering.

main_boyfriend.title: The Upgrade
main_boyfriend.text: She returned Deji's key in a Ziploc bag and blocked the G-Wagon. You're the main one now. You still check her close-friends list. Just in case.

vendor_debt.title: Co-Signed
vendor_debt.text: Locked In, with a payment plan. Mama Kemi now sends you Christmas cards. Twelve vendors have your number. Love is a shared spreadsheet.

tester.title: Passed Every Test
tester.text: She stopped testing you. She started bringing you ewa agoyin on Sundays instead of brunch. The ring light is mostly off now. She's never been happier.

counter_con.title: Soft Life, Your Account
counter_con.text: You saw the game and played it better. She's posting 'Some people are snakes 🐍' to 200k followers. You're reading it from a rooftop in VI. With her money.

survived.title: Close Friends Only
survived.text: You made her close-friends list. Not her grid. Not yet. She says 'we'll see' like a woman with options.

main_boyfriend.text: You made her close-friends list. So did a Patek. Weekdays are yours. Weekends are 'family'.

vendor_debt.text: You survived the week and so did her frontal, barely. Mama Kemi has started greeting you by name.

scandal.title: Trending With Tiwa
scandal.text: Her followers found your page, your workplace and your secondary school. A blog called you 'the soft-life sponsor'. Your aunty sent the link to the family group.

sapa.title: Brunch Broke
sapa.text: Lash appointments, sister birthdays, bottomless mimosas. Your account now has ₦312 and a debit alert from a supper club that never popped.

breakdown.title: Ring Light Burnout
breakdown.text: You started checking her stories every four minutes. Then her close friends. Then her cousin's. You cried in a Bolt on the Lekki-Epe Expressway and the driver turned off his music out of respect.

ghosted.title: Archived
ghosted.text: She didn't block you. She archived every post you were in. Your story views stopped at 'Seen by 1'. Her new brunch photos have someone else's hand in them.

fumbled.title: Failed the Only Test That Mattered
fumbled.text: She was testing for one thing: whether you'd stay kind when she looked expensive. You snooped, you posted, you called her a gold-digger to the group chat. She returned every naira. With a receipt.

obsession.title: Obsession
obsession.text: This one isn't funny. Someone stopped letting the other one leave the flat without permission. Control isn't love, whoever is doing it.

walked_away.title: Unfollowed, Unbothered
walked_away.text: You unfollowed, muted and archived. Then you bought yourself ewa agoyin under Ojuelegba bridge and ate it in peace. No ring light. No story. Bliss.
